_doc: The year (design/gdd/04-lives-and-progression.md §4.2, design/world/world-and-story.md §7.1; build item N-1.1). A life is 13 moons of 28 days: day 1 of the year is Moon 1, day 1, and the Great Eclipse is day 364 (Moon 13, day 28). Each moon is four weeks of seven days; the weekdays are ruled by the Spheres in order (weekdays: sphere id, name, glyph colour). events: the year's fixed dates the calendar can pin and skip to (id, name, moon, day, kind calamity or fixed, known: a story condition that pins it, or true). Fixed events (kind fixed, N-1.5, lives spec §6.2) also have time (of day), region, who, scene (the story scene that plays if you're in the region then), missed (effects run instead if you aren't: set, clear, learn or deed) and appointment (true when missing it costs something: the Ledger then keeps it for later lives). Each happens once a life; its date is known (pinned in gold) once you've seen it come or go in any life, and an appointment is pinned in silver.
